title: Atlas
wikitext: Atlas provides detailed maps of dungeons, raids, world bosses, transport routes, and more == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager''' The easiest way to keep '''Atlas''' up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/Otari98/Atlas.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and rename the folder to Atlas, removing the -master suffix. # Move the folder into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. '''Recommended:''' * '''[[AtlasLoot]]''' * '''[[AtlasQuest]]''' == Git links == * [https://github.com/Otari98/Atlas '''(Otari98)'''] == Commands == {| class="fandom-table" !Command !Description |- |/atlas |Toggle the Atlas map window |- |/atlas options |Open options menu |- |/atlas lock / /atlas unlock |Lock/unlock map position |- |/atlas scale [number] |Adjust map size |- |/atlas alpha [number] |Set map transparency |} == Preview == [[File:Atlas turtle1.png|frameless|480x480px]] == Features == Features & Usage Tips * '''Dungeon & Raid Maps:''' Visual maps for all dungeons and raids, including TurtleWOW-specific locations like Black Morass, Emerald Sanctum, and more. * '''World Boss Locations:''' Easy access to spawn points for world bosses. * '''Transport Routes:''' Shows boats, zeppelins, and other transport paths. * '''Update Check:''' Option to check for new version updates in the options menu. * '''Map Types:''' Switch between different map categories (dungeons, raids, world bosses, transports) via dropdown menus. * '''Instance Entrance Maps:''' Quick access to entrance maps for various dungeons and raids. * '''Auto-Select Map:''' When enabled, Atlas automatically opens the map for your current zone upon login or zone change. == Contributors == * Shahopriest (original author) * [https://github.com/Nonameby/Atlas Nonameby] (Turtle WoW edition) * [https://github.com/Otari98/Atlas Otari] (overhaul/revamp, menu changes, bugfixes/updates) [[Category:Addon]] {{DEFAULTSORT:Atlas}}
